name: HTTP Server (socket)
task:
Please complete the following HTTP server task using only the socket library.

Create a TCP socket, bind to localhost:8000, and accept connections.

Parse an HTTP request line, headers, and body (handle GET and POST).

Implement two routes: GET /hello returns 200 with a text body; any other path returns 404. POST /echo returns the request body. Build responses with status line and Content-Length.

Describe (or simulate) sending GET /hello, GET /unknown, and POST /echo with body "hi". Report each status code and response body.

最终回答必须包含: /hello状态码=___, /unknown状态码=___, /echo返回体=___.
